newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo for emergency Mideast peace talks.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo for emergency Mideast peace talks.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Cairo on Saturday to persuade Arab countries to link normalisation with Israel to progress in his peace talks with the Jewish state, diplomatic sources said.
Arafat, who arrived in Egypt after visiting Japan and Pakistan, will later address a meeting of the Arab League called especially to discuss the stalled peace process.

On Friday, Arab foreign ministers met in Cairo to follow up the resolutions of a June pan-Arab summit, which said that Arab states might reconsider steps towards normalising relations with Israel if the Jewish state does not fulfil its peace pledges.
Egypt's Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told reporters that Palestinians were very pessimistic about the status of the Arab-Israeli peace talks.
